0xarchiveio-0xarchive-quant-query.description: Query historical and real-time crypto market data from 0xArchive across two venues: Hyperliquid and Lighter. Lighter has two deployments: mainnet at /v1/lighter and Robinhood Chain at /v1/rh-lighter (USDG-quoted, e.g. BTC, AAPL-USDG). Hyperliquid includes HIP-3 builder perps (/v1/hyperliquid/hip3), HIP-4 outcome markets (/v1/hyperliquid/hip4), and Spot (/v1/hyperliquid/spot, e.g. HYPE-USDC). Covers orderbooks, trades, candles, funding, open interest, liquidations, account positions, outcome markets, TWAP, CVD, breadth, webhooks, and data quality; data types are route-specific. 0xarchiveio-0xarchive-quant-backtest.description: Quant research and backtesting on 0xArchive data, done the way a careful desk does it: hand over a wallet, a trading idea, a tweet, a Pine or TS script, a paper, someone else's backtest, or a strategy file, and get a verdict with receipts. Reverse engineers a trader's style from their fills and scores how much of their book a strategy reproduces; tests whether a trader or a strategy is skilled or lucky.
